name: Logo Close
summary: The last scene: a closing tagline or call to action builds, then shapes or the final UI resolve into the brand mark and wordmark, which hold on a clean background. It leaves the viewer with the brand and one thing to do next.
when_to_use: As the final scene of almost any explainer.
When the narration ends on a call to action or a payoff line.
To bookend a video whose opening used the same logo animation.

slots.name: tagline
slots.what: a short closing line or slogan

slots.name: cta_line
slots.what: what to do next, such as try it, visit or availability

slots.name: logo_mark
slots.what: the brand symbol as a vector

slots.name: wordmark
slots.what: the brand or product name lockup

slots.name: lead_in_visual
slots.what: the last product view or shapes that collapse into the logo

slots.name: url_or_price
slots.what: a small line under the lockup with a web address, price or date

slots.name: background
slots.what: a plain or gradient end-card field

steps: The previous scene clears, shrinks or washes out to the end-card background.
A tagline or call to action builds word by word, with keywords tinted as they are spoken.
The tagline clears and shapes or the lead-in visual converge into the logo mark.
The wordmark slides or wipes out beside or below the mark as the lockup recentres.
An optional small line with the address, price or date fades in beneath.
The lockup holds while the music finishes, then fades out to the background.

build.gsap: One timeline for the close: scale and opacity tweens to clear the last view, a per-word stagger for the tagline with an expo ease-out and colour tweens on keywords, then the logo built from shapes that tween position, scale and border radius into place with a back or expo ease-out, a mask or x tween revealing the wordmark, a long hold, and a final opacity fade.
build.remotion: A Sequence for the tagline and a later Sequence for the lockup; tagline words and logo parts each enter on a spring offset by index, the wordmark reveal uses an interpolated clip or translate, and the end of the composition holds the lockup with a closing interpolate to fade.

sound: Music carries the close and usually resolves under the held logo; a reverse swoosh or chime often marks the logo resolving, with an occasional impact. Treat the music ending as the main cue.
caveats: Members are mixed: some shots fold a whole closing montage or a final demo into the same shot as the logo.
First-motion timing comes from a minority of shots.
Some members are only a trailing blank fade after the logo, which lowers the motion stats.
